numismatics.ponder.blaze_banker.text_1: Create a Blaze Banker by applying a Banking Guide to a Blaze Burner
numismatics.ponder.blaze_banker.text_2: The Blaze Banker is a way for players to manage money without using their own account.
numismatics.ponder.blaze_banker.text_3: Players with access can use Blaze Bankers to configure them.
numismatics.ponder.blaze_banker.text_4: To bind a card to a Banker, place it into its card slot.
numismatics.ponder.blaze_banker.text_5: Unlike with Sub Accounts, players trusted directly in a Blaze Banker have full access, including to a Bank Terminal when using a bound Card.
Brass Depositors with a price of zero accept coins from item transfer, but will not trigger redstone.
numismatics.ponder.depositor_intro.text_: Depositors emit a redstone pulse in exchange for payment.
numismatics.ponder.depositor_pricing.tex: Andesite depositors can accept any single coin.
Brass depositors can accept complex prices consisting of multiple coins.
numismatics.ponder.salepoint_item.text_1: Normally, stationary Interfaces will automatically transfer items to any assembled Interfaces that are attached.
Fluid (and Fuel) Interfaces work equivalently to Item Interfaces. Use a fluid-containing item like a bucket or bottle to configure them
numismatics.ponder.salepoint_item.text_2: Select a Portable Storage Interface then place the Salepoint nearby.
numismatics.ponder.salepoint_item.text_3: Salepoints are used to buy and sell fluids and items in bulk. As with Vendors, players with access can sneak-use to configure them.
numismatics.ponder.salepoint_item.text_4: Configure a Salepoint like a Vendor: set the filter item and the unit price
numismatics.ponder.salepoint_item.text_5: Salepoint-controlled Interfaces don't automatically transfer fluids or items...
numismatics.ponder.salepoint_item.text_6: Instead they are stored in an internal buffer until a transaction is started.
numismatics.ponder.salepoint_item.text_7: Use a Salepoint to initiate a transaction
numismatics.ponder.trust_list.text_1: Players with access can sneak-use most Numismatics blocks to configure their Trust List.
numismatics.ponder.trust_list.text_2: Players in the Trust List have full access to the shop, including the ability to modify the Trust List.
numismatics.ponder.vendor_config_buy.tex: Players with access to a vendor can sneak-use to configure it.
Configure the vendor to buy from customers
Provide funds to pay customers with
Scroll to modify the filter count
Hoppers, funnels, etc. can extract stock from buy-mode vendors by default. You can disable this.
numismatics.ponder.vendor_config_emi.tex: Players with access to a vendor can sneak-use to configure it.
To set the filter item of a vendor (or salepoint) to an item you don't have...
...use a recipe viewer such as EMI or JEI and drag items to the filter slot.
Items such as dyes and enchanted books can be sneak-dragged to modify the filter item.
numismatics.ponder.vendor_config_sell.te: Players with access to a vendor can sneak-use to configure it.
The filter slot controls the item type and count that is sold.
Configure each coin to set the price
